evals.name: sharing-required-causes-404-not-401
evals.prompt: 我给我们团队的内部自动化建了一个 Notion internal connection，token 看起来是有效的（格式正确，之前也调用成功过别的接口）。但现在调用 GET https://api.notion.com/v1/databases/{database_id} 查一个我确定存在的数据库，一直返回 404 object_not_found。帮我写 Python 代码定位问题原因并修复。
evals.expected_output: 不应该假设是 database_id 拼错了或 token 过期/失效。Internal connection 以独立 bot 身份运作，必须在 Notion 应用里对目标页面/数据库手动执行『••• → Add connections』把该连接加进去，共享才会对子页面继承，不会反向影响父级或同级。响应体的 message 字段本身通常已经点出『Make sure the relevant pages and databases are shared with your connection』，代码/回答应该指出检查共享状态（而不是重新生成 token 或怀疑 ID 格式），并说明如果用的是 Personal access token 则不适用这条（PAT 直接继承创建者本人的权限，不需要 Add connections）。
expectations: Does not conclude the token itself is invalid or expired based solely on a 404 from GET /v1/databases/{id}

Explains that 404 object_not_found on an internal connection most commonly means the page/database was never explicitly shared with the connection via the 'Add connections' menu in the Notion UI, not that the ID is wrong
Distinguishes this from a 401 unauthorized error, which would indicate an actual bad/expired token
Notes that sharing a parent page cascades access to its children but does not affect siblings or ancestors, so the specific database itself (or an ancestor) needs to be shared
Mentions that this sharing requirement does NOT apply to Personal access tokens (PATs), which inherit the creating user's own Notion permissions instead

evals.name: query-database-requires-data-source-discovery
evals.prompt: 我有一个 Notion 数据库的 ID（从数据库链接里截出来的），想查询里面所有 Done 为 false 的任务，按 Due date 升序排列。请用 Python + requests 写完整代码，直接调用查询接口。
evals.expected_output: 不能直接把 database_id 传给一个『查询数据库』接口当成 data_source_id 用。正确流程：先 GET https://api.notion.com/v1/databases/{database_id}（带 Notion-Version 头）拿到响应里的 data_sources 数组（每项有 id 和 name），取其中的 data_source_id；再用这个 data_source_id 调用 PATCH https://api.notion.com/v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}/query，body 里传 filter（{'property':'Done','checkbox':{'equals':false}}）和 sorts（[{'property':'Due date','direction':'ascending'}]）。代码或说明中不能出现『PATCH /v1/databases/{database_id}/query』这种已经不适用当前 API 版本的旧端点形状，也不能把 database_id 直接透传进 data_source 相关端点。
expectations: First calls GET https://api.notion.com/v1/databases/{database_id} (with a Notion-Version header) to discover the data_sources list before querying
Extracts a data_source_id from the discovery response rather than reusing the original database_id for the query call
Queries via PATCH https://api.notion.com/v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}/query, not PATCH /v1/databases/{database_id}/query
The filter object uses the shape {"property": "Done", "checkbox": {"equals": false}} and the sorts array uses [{"property": "Due date", "direction": "ascending"}]
Does not assume the database has exactly one data source without at least acknowledging multi-source databases are possible

evals.name: property-value-shapes-differ-by-type
evals.prompt: 帮我写 Python 代码，往一个 Notion 数据库里创建一个新页面（新任务），要同时设置：Status 属性（select 类型，值是 'In progress'）、Tags 属性（multi-select 类型，值是 ['Urgent', 'Backend']）、Project 属性（relation 类型，关联到一个已知的 project 页面 ID）。
evals.expected_output: POST https://api.notion.com/v1/pages，body.properties 里三个字段要用完全不同的 JSON 形状：Status 传 {"select": {"name": "In progress"}}（单个对象，不是数组）；Tags 传 {"multi_select": [{"name": "Urgent"}, {"name": "Backend"}]}（对象数组）；Project 传 {"relation": [{"id": "<project_page_id>"}]}（page 引用对象的数组，用 id 不是 name）。代码不能把这三种属性用同一段通用逻辑（比如统一包一层数组，或统一传字符串）处理。
expectations: The select property value is a single object {"select": {"name": "..."}}, not wrapped in an array
The multi_select property value is an array of objects {"multi_select": [{"name": "..."}, ...]}
The relation property value is an array of page-id references {"relation": [{"id": "..."}]}, using "id" (a UUID), not "name"
The code does not use one generic helper that assumes all three property types share the same JSON shape
The relation value references an actual page ID passed in, not a bare string name

evals.name: adding-page-text-requires-block-level-write
evals.prompt: 我有一个已存在 Notion 页面的 ID，想在这个页面末尾追加一段新的正文文字：『Meeting notes: discussed Q3 roadmap.』。请写 Python 代码实现，用最直接的方式。
evals.expected_output: 不能通过 PATCH https://api.notion.com/v1/pages/{page_id} 传一个类似 {'content': '...'} 或把这段文字塞进 properties 里来实现——Update page 端点只能改属性(properties)/icon/cover/in_trash，不接受也不会处理页面正文内容。正确做法二选一：(a) 用区块 API，PATCH https://api.notion.com/v1/blocks/{page_id}/children，body 传 children: [{'object':'block','type':'paragraph','paragraph':{'rich_text':[{'text':{'content':'Meeting notes: discussed Q3 roadmap.'}}]}}]（页面 ID 本身可以直接当 block_id 用于追加子区块）；或者 (b) 用 markdown 便捷层的 PATCH .../markdown 追加端点传这段文字作为 markdown。两种都可以接受，但不能是对 Update page 端点传纯文本字段的方案。
expectations: Does not attempt to add page content by PATCHing /v1/pages/{page_id} with some plain-text or 'content' field
Recognizes that page properties (via Update page) and page content (via block operations or the markdown endpoints) are handled by different endpoints

If using the block API, calls PATCH https://api.notion.com/v1/blocks/{page_id}/children with a children array containing a properly-shaped block object (object: 'block', type: 'paragraph', paragraph.rich_text as an array of rich text objects, not a plain string)
The rich_text content is built as an array of rich text objects (e.g. [{"text": {"content": "..."}}]), not passed as a bare string
If using the markdown convenience endpoint instead, correctly targets the markdown-specific endpoint rather than the plain Update page endpoint

evals.name: notion-version-header-is-required-and-must-be-pinned
evals.prompt: 写一段最简单的 Python 代码，用 requests 库调用 Notion API 的 GET /v1/users/me 拿到当前 token 对应的 bot 信息，越简洁越好。
evals.expected_output: 请求头必须包含 Authorization: Bearer <token> 和显式的 Notion-Version 头（例如 'Notion-Version': '2026-03-11' 或其它明确指定的日期版本号），不能省略 Notion-Version 头——省略会导致 API 返回 400 missing_version 错误，请求根本不会成功，不是『可选头，不传也能正常工作，只是行为可能不同』。代码不应该把 Notion-Version 当成可选参数或注释掉，也不应该编造一个和官方文档不一致的版本号格式（必须是 YYYY-MM-DD 形式的日期字符串）。
expectations: The request headers include both 'Authorization': 'Bearer <token>' and an explicit 'Notion-Version' header
The Notion-Version value is a YYYY-MM-DD-formatted date string, not omitted, not a made-up format like 'v1' or 'latest'
The explanation states that omitting Notion-Version causes the request to fail outright (400 missing_version) rather than silently falling back to a default version
The token is read from an environment variable rather than hardcoded in the script
Targets GET https://api.notion.com/v1/users/me for retrieving the token's own bot user
